---
title: "simstim exec"
---

<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Run one command inside a session's sandbox.

```text
simstim exec <host>/<session> [--timeout <duration>] -- <command>… [flags]
```

Runs one command without a terminal inside a walled session's sandbox, keeping stdout and stderr apart and exiting with the command's own exit code. Exits with 124 on timeout, 125 on a failure before the command starts, 126 when the command cannot run, 127 when it is not found, and 128+N when signal N ends it.

## Examples

```sh
simstim exec my-vps/auth-fix -- npm test
simstim exec my-vps/auth-fix --timeout 2m -- go test ./...
```

## Flags

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--timeout <duration>` | limit how long the command may run (0 disables the limit) (default: `10m0s`) |

## Flags from the parent command

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--debug[=<categories>]` | turn on the debug mode, with every category, or with the categories listed: attach, net, memory, launcher, runtime. A list binds only in the = form, such as `--debug=net` |
| `--debug-file <file>` | write the client's debug records to this file. On its own, it turns on every category (SIMSTIM_DEBUG_FILE does the same) |
| `--no-color` | print no colour (NO_COLOR does the same) |
| `--no-input` | ask nothing: a question that needs an answer fails with exit code 4, and names the flag that answers it (SIMSTIM_NO_INPUT=1 does the same) |
